decision_sequence.applies_when: The adapter identity, orientation, matching semantics, or use of detection remains unresolved after inspecting library metadata and declared inputs.
decision_sequence.question: Which library-supported adapter sequence and orientation, or explicitly approved detection policy, should govern this run?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Use the adapter identity from library-preparation metadata and never guess a sequence; approve detection only as an explicit, recorded alternative.

decision_sequence.applies_when: Any quality encoding or quality, minimum-length, N-base, or paired-filter setting required by the requested operation remains unresolved.
decision_sequence.question: Which assay- and downstream-justified quality encoding, trimming, and filtering settings should be applied?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: State every enabled and disabled filter explicitly and use no universal threshold; choose values justified by the assay and downstream minimum usable read length.

decision_sequence.applies_when: Unique sample membership or R1/R2 pairing remains ambiguous after bounded metadata inspection.
decision_sequence.question: Which explicit sample and mate mapping should the run use?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Provide one unique sample identifier and R1/R2 role for every file before processing.

runtime_verification.reason: Cutadapt and fastp are external applications that create sequencing outputs. Complex-tool execution and scientific output evaluation were deliberately skipped for this instruction-only preview.
